name: Automate Business Workflows
description: Systematic workflow for identifying, designing, implementing, and monitoring business process automation. Covers auditing manual processes, selecting automation tools, building workflows with no-code and code-based solutions, and measuring the ROI of automation investments. Use when the user wants to automate business workflows or needs a structured multi-step process for this goal. Do NOT use when the request is a single-step task or requires professional advice beyond educational guidance.
